text: In 2020, Klidje, a teenager from his native country, was signed by the French club Bordeaux, which was then competing in Ligue 1; however, he only made five appearances for the first team.
During the 2021-22 season, those games took place in the French top division, prior to Klidje's transfer to Luzern in the subsequent season.
